name: buf
description: Protobuf tooling for linting, breaking change detection, and code generation
installHint: Installed via the GitHub release binary (https://github.com/bufbuild/buf/releases) on Linux/macOS, or `winget install Bufbuild.Buf` on Windows. The handler downloads buf-<Linux|Darwin>-<x86_64|arm64> directly — no shell script required.
notes: Pinned to 1.37.0 alongside packages/proto codegen. Bump in lockstep with the proto-codegen byte-stability gate (`make check`).
